_why: Ground truth for the fingerprint: would a stranger say these two came from
one tool, or from two different studios?
Judged BLIND, from the first-viewport screenshots alone, with no axis
values in view. The first version of this file was contaminated — four of
four 'different' verdicts were justified in the vector's own vocabulary
(mood, accent, layout bias, leads-with), so agreement was measuring the
instrument against a restatement of itself. Every `why` below describes
what is on the screen. If a verdict cannot be written that way it is not a
The rule that resolves the near-ties: a difference in COLOUR or SUBJECT
alone is not a different site. Two pages that share a skeleton, a type
treatment and a first screen are the same site painted twice, whatever the
accent and whoever is in the photograph.
Shreyas sells these pages and should overwrite any of them.
